description: Change a Link in Bio link (`id` from get_link_in_bio): only the fields sent change. `enabled: false` hides it without deleting it. Paid-only fields (start_date, end_date, animation, passcode protection) return FEATURE_NOT_IN_PLAN on the free on-domain plan.

animation.description: Draw attention to the link; null removes. Paid plans only.

domain.description: Domain whose Link in Bio page this is, e.g. `example.com`.

dry_run.description: Validate and preview without changing anything.

enabled.description: false hides the link without deleting it.

end_date.description: Hide the link after this time; same format. Paid plans only.

value.description: The passcode for `code`; minimum age 18, 21 or 25 for `birthday`.

protection.description: What a visitor must do before the link opens: `code` = enter a passcode (paid plans), `birthday` = confirm their age, `sensitive` = a content warning. null removes it.

start_date.description: Show the link from this time: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601, UTC unless an offset is given; null clears. Paid plans only.

title.description: Text on the button or heading.

type.description: `link` (default), `featured` (shown larger) or `category` (a heading with no url).

url.description: http(s) address; a bare host gets https:// added. Not for a category.

name: edit_link_in_bio_link
title: Edit Link In Bio Link
